name: Honda CR80R / CR85R
engine: 80 or 85 cc two-stroke single, liquid-cooled on most years, carb, premix
intro: Honda's mini motocross two-strokes. Premix, a top end that wears fast and small parts that are easy to lose.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Honda dealer to run the VIN as well.
